projectSummary: Q1 - 2026 Kickoff campaign aligns business priorities and establishes a 90 day sprint target for the brand.
detailSummary: FY26 Strategic Program synchronizes automation, product, client success, and growth labs into a single roadmap that protects renewals and unlocks expansion. The initiative creates shared accountability, shared dashboards, and repeatable playbooks that every pod can use to execute against the annual plan.
detailHighlights: Codifies quarterly milestones across automation, GTM enablement, and client success operations.
Funds experimentation pods to validate two net-new service offerings before Q3 FY26.
Rolls out a unified metrics layer so leadership can review health, risk, and pipeline in a single workspace.
